messages:
alex_m: Heads-up — spot availability for A100s in us-east1 has been steadily dropping for the last 20m. Grafana panel showing capacity signal -> https://grafana/redwood/d/spot-us-east1

maria_ops: saw that too. interruption_count spiked ~15m ago. Is this across all zones or a single AZ?

devon_sre: single AZ (us-east1-b) shows the worst, but usable capacity across b/c/a all trending down. pinging cloud provider support.

raj_eng: can we get a quick interruption-rate alert? current SLOs for hosted API p95 gen latency are already creeping up ~120ms.

alex_m: yes. proposal: add an alert combining capacity-signal and interruption-rate so we avoid noisy single-metric pages. e.g. capacity < 0.3 AND interruption_rate > 2% over 10m -> page.

jin_platform: sounds good. also want an early-warning slack-only alert at capacity < 0.5 or interruption_rate > 1% so we can preemptively shift routing.

opsbot: automated message: cloud_spot_interruptions_total{region="us-east1",gpu="a100"} increased by 42 in the last 10m.

maria_ops: +1 to the two-tier approach. page-on for >10m sustained AND secondary channel slack-only for short blips.

devon_sre: draft PromQL for page alert:
```promql
avg_over_time(cloud_spot_capacity{region="us-east1",gpu="a100"}[10m]) < 0.30
and
(increase(cloud_spot_interruptions_total{region="us-east1",gpu="a100"}[10m]) / max(1, increase(cloud_spot_requests_total{region="us-east1",gpu="a100"}[10m]))) > 0.02
```
FOR 5m -> PAGE

raj_eng: for the slack-only warn rule:
```promql
avg_over_time(cloud_spot_capacity{region="us-east1",gpu="a100"}[5m]) < 0.50
or
(increase(cloud_spot_interruptions_total{region="us-east1",gpu="a100"}[5m]) / max(1, increase(cloud_spot_requests_total{region="us-east1",gpu="a100"}[5m]))) > 0.01
```
post to #eng-infra and #platform-ops.

alex_m: runbook notes: on page -> 1) validate provider incident, 2) check mixed-capacity pool health (percent spots vs on-demand), 3) if spot capacity below threshold, trigger automated fallback to on-demand for affected routes, 4) escalate to SRE if routing fails.

maria_ops: also include step to check model-variant fallback — we have lower-memory quantized variants that can run on smaller GPU types in other regions. Might reduce on-demand spend.

devon_sre: auto-fallback idea: config a weighted pool: prefer spot 70%, on-demand 30% per region, with dynamic error budget. When slack-warning fires, shift to 50/50 for 30m. If page fires, shift to 0/100 for affected queues. Need a rollout to ensure no thundering.

jin_platform: I'll add a feature flag to the runtime config to accept 'spot_degradation_mode' so we can test gradual shifts. Also adding a circuit-breaker to prevent switching too often.

alex_m: cost tradeoff note: on-demand is ~3x spot unit cost in our contracts — shifting entire fleet will burn dollars but protects SLOs. We'll need a temporary alert to finance for any >24h sustained on-demand fallback.

raj_eng: can we add an SLO impact panel to the alert payload? e.g. include current p95 latency delta and error-rate delta in the slack message so responders see customer impact.

maria_ops: yes, add these to the Slack template. example payload fields: region, gpu_type, capacity_signal, interruption_rate, p95_delta, error_rate_1h.

devon_sre: created a short grafana dashboard mock and linked it in the alert. also added an annotations panel with recent spot preemption logs and node-replacement counts.

opsbot: automated action suggestion: when slack-warning escalates, suggest running:
`./bin/traffic-shift --region us-east1 --gpu a100 --from spot --to on-demand --percent 30 --duration 30m`
(ops only).

jin_platform: test plan: run a red-team simulation next week where we artificially lower the capacity signal for 30m and exercise the alerting + automated fallback. schedule on Wed.

alex_m: agree. assignable followups: jin to add flag + circuit-breaker, devon to author PromQL alerts and grafana panel, maria to update runbook + slack templates, raj to add SLO fields to alert payload, opsbot will run simulated action during test.

maria_ops: rough ETA ~48h for alert + dashboard. Jin, Devon can you confirm?

devon_sre: can deliver rules + dashboard in 36h.

jin_platform: adding flag and basic circuit in 48h.

alex_m: thanks everyone. will loop in finance if a fallback crosses 24h. ping in thread once dashboards are live. :thumbsup:
